hero.title: How nurse practitioners are shaping the future of primary care.
hero.mission: Our lab studies the primary care nurse practitioner workforce, value-based payment models, and emerging models of care such as NP-owned practices and home-based primary care, using national Medicare claims analyses and statewide surveys.

researchTopics.label: Governance & Regulation
researchTopics.question: Does state scope-of-practice authority determine how NPs actually practice?
researchTopics.blurb: This research area examines how state-level scope-of-practice laws shape what nurse practitioners are actually able to do in day-to-day practice, and where regulation and reality diverge.

researchTopics.label: Workforce & Access
researchTopics.question: Is NP workforce growth translating into better access to primary care?
researchTopics.blurb: This research area tracks nurse practitioner workforce growth over time and asks whether that growth is actually closing primary care access gaps, especially in underserved communities.

researchTopics.label: Care Delivery
researchTopics.question: What new models of NP-led care best serve underserved communities?
researchTopics.blurb: This research area evaluates emerging models of nurse-practitioner-led care delivery and their effectiveness in reaching communities that have historically had limited access to primary care.
